scenarios.name: bear
scenarios.reason: secular leg: AI substitution erodes the labor-arbitrage model; revenue −10% from LTM (revision breadth FQ3 0↑/14↓ extrapolated); margin below the FY25 worst (9.53%) as pricing grinds — floored by the variable-cost model, not collapsed; multiple holds near the post-2022 trough region (band min 4.26x, current 4.87x @ 2.6th pctile) — secular gets no re-rate.

scenarios.name: base
scenarios.reason: margin = post-2022 regime median 11.10% minus a ~60bps trajectory haircut: the regime's most recent year (FY25, 9.53%) is its worst and revision breadth is 0↑/14↓, so the live-regime median likely overstates the forward mid-cycle. Explicitly NOT the 10y blend (11.9% — straddles the 2022 break), NOT pre-war (13.27% — dead regime), NOT consensus recovery (~15.6% EBIT — the Street's base is our bull). Revenue = consensus FY26E. Multiple below the 15.16x post-2022 median: the AI-substitution question earns a durable discount even at mid-cycle.

scenarios.name: bull
scenarios.reason: cyclical air-pocket resolves: the delivery rebuild completes and margin recovers toward but below the pre-war median (13.27%) and well below consensus (~15.6%); revenue = consensus FY27E; multiple toward but below the post-2022 75th pctile (20.09x).
